originalCompoundQuestion: What are the three explicit device-modeling layers, and which layer owns placement of atomic components?

requiredClaims: Atomic components are small reusable pieces with stable local interfaces.
They are independent from the device shell.
Layer 2 is a bounded functional module combining atomics for one purpose.
The module owns placement of its atomic components.
Atomics retain lineage and detachable identities when the repair loop may expose them.
Layer 3 is the device-specific interior and shell contract.
It owns serviceability concerns such as mounts, routing and removal order.
It decides which reusable pieces to instantiate and which device-specific geometry to create.
